name: Mr. Purple
address: 180 Orchard St, 15th Floor (Hotel Indigo Lower East Side), New York, NY 10002
status_note: Official site is current, with a fall menu, 2026 hours, and live SevenRooms and SpeakeasyGo booking links. Hours have changed since August: it now opens at 4pm on weekdays, not 1pm.

dress.detail: The official site asks guests to follow its attire guidelines and dress in an 'upscale', fashion-forward way. The Rooftop Guide says smart casual, with no flip-flops, sportswear or torn clothes. The IHG and OpenTable listings say casual, probably meaning daytime dining.

cover.value: None listed; walk-ins welcome, and the door host has final say

getting_in.value: Walk-ins welcome, but the door host and management decide admittance. Book dining on SevenRooms and events on SpeakeasyGo. Reservations recommended in the evening; it gets crowded, so arrive early.

price.value: Cocktails $20-23; happy hour Mon-Fri 4-7pm with $11 cocktails and wine

subway.value: Lower East Side-2nd Ave (F), about 1 block (~3 min walk)

sources.name: HotelPlanner - Hotel Indigo Lower East Side listing

skip_if: You hate crowds: reviewers say it gets packed and recommend arriving early to get in.
You want a swim: the terrace pool is small and decorative more than swimmable.
